mapper.sql: SELECT ar.*, s.student_no, s.name AS student_name, fm.name AS from_mentor_name, fl.name AS from_lab_name, tm.name AS to_mentor_name, tl.name AS to_lab_name, u.display_name AS operator_name FROM adjustment_record ar JOIN student s ON s.id = ar.student_id LEFT JOIN mentor fm ON fm.id = ar.from_mentor_id LEFT JOIN lab fl ON fl.id = ar.from_lab_id LEFT JOIN mentor tm ON tm.id = ar.to_mentor_id LEFT JOIN lab tl ON tl.id = ar.to_lab_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ar.operator_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO adjustment_record (batch_id, student_id, from_mentor_id, from_lab_id, to_mentor_id, to_lab_id, type, status, reason, operator_id) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{studentId}, #{fromMentorId}, #{fromLabId}, #{toMentorId}, #{toLabId}, #{type}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: WHERE ar.batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY ar.created_at DESC, ar.id DESC
WHERE ar.batch_id = #{batchId} AND ar.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY ar.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adjustment_record WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
